q: Does the annual environment statement to the pollution board cover our carbon emissions?
title: Environment statement and carbon
short: No. The environment statement in Form V, filed under the Environment (Protection) Rules, covers water and raw material use, pollutants discharged and waste. It does not ask for greenhouse gas emissions. Its consumption figures can still be a useful cross check for your carbon inventory.
audience: Factories that file an annual environment statement

sections.h: What it shares with a carbon inventory
ul: Fuel used where it is reported for air emissions.

p: Scope 1, 2 or 3 emissions. These come from your fuel, electricity and purchase records under the GHG Protocol.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.

sources.label: Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986, Rule 14 and Form V (moef.gov.in)
